provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Entire assigned HTML, sources, independent check and both retained research reports read locally, plus layout JSON. No external lookup or new source verification. Original URL dates follow retained ledger; failed register access remains unknown with attempt date separately stated. Original research model and publication date remain unknown.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original managed search/fetch backends used browser profiles not certified clean (research, search-plain, detars). Later clean-context attempt403/direct HTTP reads/local layout checks cannot retrospectively satisfy strict clean-session provenance. Failed Swiftrider/Customs paths were not evidence. No new browser/network route used in localization. Historical no-contact claims are retained statements, not a replay certification of prior execution.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Arithmetic/calendar and mechanical delivery passed within original scope; NO OVERALL PASS. New locale drafts incorporate supported F02–F08 clarifications: portal discrepancy, approved examiner/non-pregnancy/fit-to-travel, QMS delay/amendments, Customs permit validity, crate recovery trigger, chip reader exception and ties-to-even rounding. F01 historical session failure and F09 operational unknowns remain open. No original file changed.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: Original layout-check.json read for source context only. Original screenshots/browser results are not new-page render or visual certification; author did not rerun them. Director handles package rendering separately.

datePolicy: Original ledger explicitly dates source reads November 7, 2026; source-specific dates and extraction limits retained. Failed recognised-agent register has unknown accessDate and November 7 attemptDate. Announced December 1, 2026 AQC rates used for June 2027, no future rule/quote guarantee. Copy editing is not a source refresh.

planningAssumptions.planningStartStatus: Author buffer judgment, not statutory deadline or guarantee of kennel/flight availability
planningAssumptions.dog: One four-year-old18kg microchipped mixed-breed dog vaccinated in Shanghai; actual records/classification not supplied or independently verified

fx.status: Round planning conversion factors, not observed market exchange rates

planningAssumptions.baseline: Exactly30 aircon AQC days, gross annual unsterilised licence90 because status unknown, normal import50, manifest cargo, no pet-import tax in totals pending determination. China allowances7700–17800CNY, SG subtotal2833SGD. All allowances unconfirmed.
planningAssumptions.rounding: Two decimals ROUND_HALF_EVEN; SGD from unrounded converted totals. Four contingency CNY half-cent ties deliberately end .72.
planningAssumptions.coordinationPremium: Hypothetical6000–12000CNY coordination-only increment over hybrid, excludes clearance and pass-through; not advertised provider package
planningAssumptions.contingency: 15 percent judgment, not fee or cap; unresolved extras still separate

uncertainties: No individual dog breed, sterilisation, chip/vaccine/lab records or measurements verified. Mainland-China Schedule III minimum quarantine remains even with titre pass; no AQC space/release date confirmed.
No private estate/landlord consent or individual HDB/ADORE eligibility confirmed; BCA context outside original narrow core-source whitelist remains supplementary/unconfirmed.

PALS/GoBusiness source discrepancy unresolved. Customs same-transport relief is not automatic EP exemption; cargo relief, valuation, pet GST and declaring/permit charges remain open. No tax rate asserted.

Shanghai official-hosted but non-direct-GACC workflow remains unconfirmed under original source scope. Final seven-day AVS exam/endorsement and cargo-specific export channel must be coordinated; no holiday-adjusted exact deadline claimed.

No June2027 flight/operator/aircraft/station/pet slot approval, lab shipment or cargo rate; heat/ground exposure/substitution, crate/gross weight and different carrier breed rules remain go/no-go checks. Current MU form resolved older form conflict only, not actual summer acceptance.
Pawsport recognition, taxes, inclusions and future price unchecked. No routine appointment-inspection tariff or airline-handler holding fee established; CAPQ35/day is not airline tariff.

Budget excludes pet-import tax, beyond-reserve cargo customs charges, extra quarantine/treatment/tests/vaccines, rebooking/holding, oversized-crate recovery, breed premiums/bank fees and housing/boarding/passenger travel. Reserve250SGD and15percent contingency are not caps; freight can exceed allowance.

Strict original clean-browser-session requirement not satisfied; later checks do not cure history. Mechanical/arithmetic correctness is not overall compliance, verified price, transport approval or execution readiness.

localeReason: Chinese is directly useful to Shanghai Chinese-speaking pet owners handling local veterinary/export records and Singapore arrival planning. Simplified Chinese is the package locale; translation changes no breed, housing, tax or transport eligibility.
